artifacts.description: Parses the image clips in the Honeyboard clipboard folder (extensionless JPEG 'clip' files). artifacts.name: Samsung Badge Provider
artifacts.description: App icon badge counts recorded by the Samsung badge provider (badge.db, apps table): the package and activity each badge belongs to, its count, and the hidden and extraData columns as stored.

artifacts.name: SDHMS Battery App History

artifacts.name: SDHMS Battery Event History

artifacts.name: SDHMS Battery System History
artifacts.description: System power drain recorded in time windows by the Samsung Device Health Manager Service (sec_batterystats_history, SYSTEM_HISTORY table). The drain type is stored as a raw integer and is reported as-is.

artifacts.description: Parses the `routine` table of com.samsung.android.app.routines/databases/routine.db, which holds the named Bixby Routines automations stored on the device. artifacts.name: Samsung Bixby Routines - Routine Run History
artifacts.description: Parses the routine_running_history table of com.samsung.android.app.routines/databases/routine.db, which records a named routine against a timestamp.

artifacts.name: Samsung Bixby Routines - Routine Conditions
artifacts.description: Parses the condition_instance table of com.samsung.android.app.routines/databases/routine.db, the per-routine trigger wiring: which condition tag, from which package, with which stored parameters, is attached to which routine.

artifacts.name: Samsung Bixby Routines - Routine Actions
artifacts.description: Parses the action_instance table of com.samsung.android.app.routines/databases/routine.db, the per-routine action wiring: which action tag, from which package, with which stored parameters, is attached to which routine.

artifacts.name: Samsung Bixby Routines - Saved Places
artifacts.description: Parses the location_history table of com.samsung.android.app.routines/databases/routine.db, which stores a coordinate pair with an address, locality and keyword label.

artifacts.name: Samsung Bixby Routines - Service Log
artifacts.description: Parses the routine_history table of com.samsung.android.app.routines/databases/routine.db, an internal timestamped log kept by the Routines background service (job scheduling, metaloader and catalog-update events, widget provider callbacks).

artifacts.name: Samsung Bixby Routines - App Preferences
artifacts.description: Parses the key/value preference table of com.samsung.android.app.routines/databases/routine.db, which holds app-level key and value pairs, some of them millisecond time values.

artifacts.name: SDHMS Config Reload History

artifacts.name: SDHMS Netstat
artifacts.description: Rows of the NETSTAT table of the SDHMS thermal_log database: a time window, package name, uid and net_usage as stored. More info: https://bebinary4n6.blogspot.com/2026/01/inside-android-samsung-dhms-extracting.html

artifacts.name: SDHMS Temperature Logs
artifacts.description: SDHMS temperature log, one row per reading with each sensor column divided by 10. More info: https://bebinary4n6.blogspot.com/2026/01/inside-android-samsung-dhms-extracting.html

artifacts.name: SDHMS CPU Stats
artifacts.description: Rows of the CPUSTAT table of the SDHMS thermal_log database: a time window, uptime, process name, uid, pid and the process_usage figure as stored. More info: https://bebinary4n6.blogspot.com/2026/01/inside-android-samsung-dhms-extracting.html

artifacts.name: Samsung Gallery Hidden Album
artifacts.description: Rows of the files table in the Samsung Gallery secured.db, with the media file each row's _data path points at when that file was extracted from sec_pass storage

artifacts.description: Parses the IMS public user identity Samsung stores in com.sec.imsservice, one row per saved entry, with the key (an IMSI on the tested images) and the SIP or TEL URI stored against it.

artifacts.name: Samsung IMS Registration Events
artifacts.description: Parses the IMS registration log Samsung writes in com.sec.imsservice, one row per RegiMgr line, with the SIM slot, carrier profile and registration state where a line carries them, as stored.

artifacts.name: Samsung IMS PDN Network Events
artifacts.description: Parses the IMS packet data network log Samsung writes in com.sec.imsservice, with the interface, link addresses and P-CSCF addresses where a line carries them, as stored.

artifacts.description: Parses the IMS SIM manager log Samsung writes in com.sec.imsservice, with the SIM slot and the carrier MNO and MVNO names as stored.

artifacts.name: Samsung Media Provider - Locations
artifacts.description: Entries in the Samsung media provider's location table (media.db): coordinates with country, locality, street and address text, and the database each row came from.

artifacts.name: Samsung Notes
artifacts.description: Rows of the sdoc table in each Samsung Notes sdoc.db found, with the note's title, text, stored times and the media files kept in the note's own media folder.

artifacts.name: Samsung Privacy Dashboard Permission Access
artifacts.description: Permission accesses logged by the Samsung Privacy Dashboard (permission_db, permissionAccessInformations table): the accessing package, permission group, access time and the BACKGROUND value as stored. The operation code is stored as a raw integer and is reported as-is.

artifacts.name: Samsung Cloud Platform Devices
artifacts.description: Devices recorded by the Samsung Cloud Platform Manager (scpmv2.db, devices table): device alias, model, OS version, country and SIM codes, with the registration and last access times.

artifacts.name: Samsung Secure Folder - History Log
artifacts.description: Parses the Samsung Secure Folder HistoryLog database (com.samsung.knox.securefolder; the upstream tool describes the Secure Folder as Android user 150, and this parser reads any database under that package's databases folder that holds a HistoryLog table) and reconstructs folder move-in/move-out activity between the two profile ids each message names. Request and result records are paired by this parser: a result is matched to an earlier request with the same direction no more than 30 minutes before it, scored on the time gap and on whether the counts agree. The parser uses no stored link between the two. Each event shows direction, source app, requested and moved counts and folder paths. Moved Count is the Total value when the result gives no moved count. The Status, Source Path Note and Warnings columns say when a record was not paired or a source path was derived.

artifacts.name: Samsung Sleep Detection Sleep Times

artifacts.name: Samsung Story Service - Moments
